metadata.capability_extraction: Can use Move tool, drag layers, anchor floating selection (Ctrl+H), save XCF (Ctrl+S).
metadata.failure_analysis: Agent could not center the triangle precisely but demonstrated basic Move tool drag capability.
metadata.explanation: Simplified task targeting a specific quadrant (lower-right, X>500 AND Y>500) rather than exact centering. Partial credit: 0.5 per axis. Postconfig exports GIMP state as PNG. Negative control: initial PNG centroid at (218, 207) — both axes fail, initial score=0.0. [Fixed: evaluator.func was missing check_ prefix; corrected from triangle_lower_right__ to check_triangle_lower_right__]
fix_history: Fix 1: Added missing check_ prefix to evaluator.func — changed from triangle_lower_right__569dedcfdc3e7d291a20f0e6aca641c0 to check_triangle_lower_right__569dedcfdc3e7d291a20f0e6aca641c0 to match actual function name in metrics/gimp_yellow_centroid.py

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly identifies yellow pixels using reasonable color thresholds (R>150, G>100, B<100, A>50) and computes centroid from the saved PNG.
Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule': directly accesses expected.get('x_threshold') and expected.get('y_threshold') — no nested 'rules' key error.
Postconfig uses ctrl+shift+e to force-export PNG before evaluation, ensuring the getter reads the current canvas state regardless of how the agent saved.
Partial credit logic (0.5 per axis) is semantically appropriate for the two independent spatial requirements.
Coverage is complete: both the move (centroid position) and save (postconfig re-exports) requirements of the instruction are addressed.
The rule_validation_passed=false is a pre-fix artifact; the actual metric function name in the file matches evaluator.func after the applied fix.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider lowering x_threshold from 500 to ~312 (canvas width/2 = 625/2) if 'lower-right area' is meant to mean the right half rather than the rightmost ~20% of the canvas. Current threshold of 500 out of 625 is somewhat strict.
Re-run rule validation after the fix to clear the pre-fix error from validation_passed status.
